witchmod.compendium.ritual.counterplay.t:
Certain blocks/items can block these spells (curses/blessings) from being sent your way. A Ward blocks attachments cast on you by others, spending its durability. A Warding Totem shields everyone inside its radius. A Jar can capture effects, and Purifying Water burns their timers down fast when you bathe in it.

The Ledger records every hex nearby — who cast what, on whom — so nothing stays secret for long.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.discovery.tex:
You only learn an effect by experiencing it — as the caster who lands it, or the victim it happens to. Until then it is only a rumour in this book.

Discovered curses and blessings, and any modifier you've cast with, fill in their pages here automatically, turning rumours into full entries.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.essence.text:
Cursed Essence is both the fuel and the odds. The more you load into the essence slot, the higher your success chance and the lower your backfire risk.

Pay the full price and most casts can no longer backfire at all. Skimp, and the ritual is more likely to fail — or to turn on you.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.essence.title: Cursed Essence
witchmod.compendium.ritual.example.text:
Say you want to give a friend the Yap curse — a weak, harmless hex that just makes them talk too much.

1. Bottle their Player Essence: right-click them with an empty Jar, or right-click the bed they last slept in.

2. At the Ritual Table, place that essence in the target slot, a piece of Paper (Yap's sacrificial item) in the sacrificial slot, and a stack of Cursed Essence in the fuel slot.

3. The success bar climbs as you add essence. When the odds look good, press Cast.

The essence and paper are spent, and somewhere across the world your friend suddenly can't stop talking. You have now discovered Yap — its page in this book fills itself in.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.example.title: Example: A First Curse
witchmod.compendium.ritual.modifiers.tex:
The optional fourth slot holds a Modifier — a single vanilla item that bends the cast. Modifiers can make a spell cheaper, longer, guaranteed, hidden, delayed, disguised, contagious, and much more.

Each one is explained on its own page in the Modifiers chapter. You learn a modifier the first time you cast a ritual using it.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.outcome.text:
Every cast either lands or fails — there is no third outcome. Most failures simply fizzle and cost you your ingredients.

The remaining risk is a BACKFIRE: the ritual turning on the caster. That might be a mirror of the curse landing on you, your inventory scrambled, or the table exploding. Loading more essence pushes the backfire chance down to zero.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.outcome.title: Success & Backfire
witchmod.compendium.ritual.overview.text:
Bewitchment revolves around rituals cast at a Ritual Table. A ritual spends Cursed Essence and a Sacrificial Item to place a timed curse or blessing on a target.

The pages that follow walk through each part of a cast — the table, the items, the odds, and how to defend yourself. Learn these and you understand the whole mod.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.sacrifice.tex:
The item in the sacrificial slot decides WHICH curse or blessing you cast — every effect is tied to one specific item, listed on its page in this book.

Two special cases: Redstone Dust rolls a random, cheaper effect; and the Cursed, Blessed and Executioner's Coins gamble several effects at once.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.table.text:
The table has four slots. The TARGET slot takes a Player Essence (or is left empty to affect yourself). The SACRIFICIAL slot holds the item that chooses your effect. The ESSENCE slot holds Cursed Essence, the fuel. The MODIFIER slot is optional and bends the cast.

Fill the slots and press Cast. The bar shows your chance of success, with the small red cap marking your backfire risk.
witchmod.compendium.ritual.table.title: The Ritual Table
witchmod.compendium.ritual.targeting.tex:
Leave the target slot empty to affect yourself. To strike someone else, bottle their Player Essence — from the player directly, or from the bed they last slept in — and place it in the target slot. Distance does not matter.

A bound Voodoo Doll also works as a target, and casting a curse while carrying one can redirect it entirely.

witchmod.compendium.title: Compendium
witchmod.compendium.mod.amethyst_shard.d: Makes the cast cheaper if the target already carries an effect of the same category.
witchmod.compendium.mod.bell.desc: Adds a flat 15 minutes to the duration, and announces the cast to the whole server when it lands.
witchmod.compendium.mod.clock.desc: +15% cost. Forces the effect's duration to a fixed 45 minutes, overriding the random roll.
witchmod.compendium.mod.compass.desc: +5% cost. Fixes the effect's duration at 40 minutes, overriding the random roll.
witchmod.compendium.mod.dragons_breath.d: +30% cost. On success, a quarter-duration copy also splashes onto players near the caster.
witchmod.compendium.mod.echo_shard.desc: +10% cost. Delays the effect's onset by 5-10 minutes, so it creeps in later.
witchmod.compendium.mod.eye_of_ender.des: Test the Waters. If the cast is blocked, the ritual reports back exactly what protected the target — a Ward, a Warding Totem's radius, or Holy Water — so you know what to counter.
witchmod.compendium.mod.glow_ink_sac.des: -10% cost. The target is told in chat exactly which effect they got.
witchmod.compendium.mod.goat_horn.desc: -5% cost. A loud horn blares when the effect lands, giving it away.
witchmod.compendium.mod.honeycomb.desc: +20% cost. Guarantees success on all but Major-tier effects and forces zero backfire, but cuts duration to a quarter.
witchmod.compendium.mod.ink_sac.desc: +35% cost. The effect stays hidden from the target until its own discovery moment.
+40% cost. The cast bypasses a Ward or Jar (a Warding Totem still blocks it).
witchmod.compendium.mod.netherstar.desc: +50% cost. Guarantees the cast succeeds, removing the chance of failure entirely.
witchmod.compendium.mod.paper.desc: This cast's Ledger entries are scribbled out and unreadable.
witchmod.compendium.mod.prismarine_shard: -15% cost. A simple discount on the essence a cast needs.
witchmod.compendium.mod.quartz.desc: -20% cost, but only usable on effects you've already discovered.
witchmod.compendium.mod.rabbits_foot.des: +10% cost, but -15% backfire chance — a safer cast.
witchmod.compendium.mod.recovery_compass: +15% cost. The effect does NOT persist after death (the one exception to the no-expire-on-death rule).
witchmod.compendium.mod.slime_ball.desc: +60% cost. Also plants a hidden Infectious attachment, making the target's effects contagious.
witchmod.compendium.mod.slime_block.desc: +100% cost. A stronger Infectious — the target's effects spread to nearby players.
witchmod.compendium.mod.sugar.desc: -10% cost and +10% success, but halves the effect's duration.
witchmod.compendium.mod.wither_rose.desc: +15% cost. The effect reads as the opposite category (a fake blessing/curse) until discovered.
witchmod.compendium.allergic.desc: This curse selects a random food group to be allergic to: Eating from this group provides no benefits and debuffs you significantly.
witchmod.compendium.audit.desc: This realistic curse makes it so being near valuables has a chance for a tax man to enter and take a cut of some loot, if taxed the curse will be removed. There is probably a blessing that can return these taxes...
witchmod.compendium.backseat_driver.desc: This curse makes mounts occasionally take control of themselves and do what they want... which is usually not good.
witchmod.compendium.bad_swimmer.desc: People with this curse find themselves unable to swim and sink in water.
witchmod.compendium.basement_dweller.des: A curse that makes you the average gacha player; You take damage by going outside.
witchmod.compendium.bedrock_moment.desc: A game-breaking curse that plagues the game with many different bugs, adveritsments and other annoyances, these can be simple rubberbands or elaborate 'bugs' like charged creepers in boats paying them a visit. Incredibly excessive and annoying.
witchmod.compendium.body_swapping.desc: A curse that occasionally causes the victim to swap places with players in their proximity.
witchmod.compendium.bouncy.desc: This curse makes the victim very bouncy, being loud and bouncing off many surfaces and mobs.
witchmod.compendium.broken_bonds.desc: A curse centered around breaking the bonds of victim's tamed pets; spending time near tamed animals increasingly makes them irritated and they will eventually untame and run away.
witchmod.compendium.butterfingers.desc: A curse that makes the victim likely to drop the item they are holding on occasion.
witchmod.compendium.carelessness.desc: Your health bar becomes unreadable — every heart is drawn identical and pure black — though your real health is unchanged.
witchmod.compendium.channels.desc: A confusing curse that swaps left and right audio channels around, making using headphones confusing.
witchmod.compendium.claustrophobia.desc: This curse makes the victim take ramping tick damage when covered by a roof.
witchmod.compendium.clumsy.desc: Blocks you place occasionally come out wrong: mis-rotated, one block off from where you aimed, or a different block from your hotbar.
witchmod.compendium.comic_relief.desc: A curse of pure 'bad luck'. If victims find themselves low on health or items all over the floor they may find themselves struck by a comedically-timed lightning bolt.
witchmod.compendium.cutaway_gag.desc: Victims of this curse will occasionally be pulled away from their actions to watch a cutaway gag created live using other random players, these gags are completely random and can be quite detrimental, or a useless waste of time.
witchmod.compendium.delusions.desc: This curse makes victims constantly see fake players roaming around and interacting with them, only they can see these players.
witchmod.compendium.dense.desc: You fall faster and crater the ground on hard landings, and any floor with air beneath it gives way if you loiter on it.
witchmod.compendium.dwarfism.desc: A curse that makes the victim significantly smaller and have less health, but due to their size, they can now ride players and villagers.
witchmod.compendium.echoes.desc: Victims of this curse can't help but hear sounds that aren't real or chats that aren't real.
witchmod.compendium.farmhand.desc: Nearby passive animals find themselves drawn to the victim and can't help but get in their way.
witchmod.compendium.flat_footed.desc: Makes you a very clumsy walker; You footsteps are very loud and shake the camera of people nearby, even while crouched.
witchmod.compendium.floor_is_lava.desc: Standing still for too long with this curse starts to deal tick damage.
witchmod.compendium.gassy.desc: A very funny curse that makes the victim uncontrollably fart occasionally, loud sounds or damage can also scare them into farting, launching the victim.
witchmod.compendium.giant.desc: A curse that makes the victim enormous and slow, but makes them able to stomp on entities and have increased swing range.
witchmod.compendium.glass_cannon.desc: A curse that increases the damage you receive substantially but also increases the damage you deal significantly.
witchmod.compendium.gluttony.desc: Gives the victim an additional hunger bar and a bigger appetite and body, they also take bigger bites of food.
witchmod.compendium.haunted.desc: This curse haunts the victim with a well-modeled entity only they can see, this mysterious entity does not want to be looked at and paying any attention to its presence makes it angrier. If this entity touches the victim, they die instantly.
witchmod.compendium.hiccups.desc: A curse that makes the victim hiccup constantly, hiccups disrupt movement briefly and are overall annoying.
witchmod.compendium.ice_skates.desc: This curse reduces the victim's friction, making them slide around like everything is ice.
witchmod.compendium.infectious.desc: A modifier (Slime Ball), not a curse: it makes the target's attachments contagious, spreading to whoever they touch.
witchmod.compendium.insomniac.desc: This curse makes the victim unable to sleep.
witchmod.compendium.klutz.desc: A curse that pretty much makes the victim left-handed and struggles with physical tasks, consuming huge amounts of durability on tools.
witchmod.compendium.left_handed.desc: The victim now uses the left hand (in first person) and due to this, cannot write properly in chat and has a subtle aim wobble and bloom on projectiles.
witchmod.compendium.lightweight.desc: A curse that makes the victim much more susceptible to knockback.
witchmod.compendium.loading_screen.desc: Shows you the power of the Creation Engine™ by taking the time to open a loading screen everytime a door or equivalent is used.
witchmod.compendium.magnet.desc: Projectiles are drawn to victims of this curse.
witchmod.compendium.martyrdom.desc: Dying with this curse causes you to explode.
A minor curse that forces the victim out of fullscreen for the duration.
witchmod.compendium.moonwalker.desc: The victim is unable to press W and has to walk backwards.
witchmod.compendium.munchies.desc: People with this curse gain significantly less saturation from food, making them constantly have to eat.
witchmod.compendium.narcolepsy.desc: Makes the victim uncontrollably fall asleep at random times, and have to button mash to wake up. Players cannot do anything in this state and the sleep can be of varying deepness.
witchmod.compendium.narrator.desc: A curse that makes a disembodied voice narrate the victim's actions to them and all nearby players. This uses Minecraft's TTS so if you're not on Windows you will not be able to hear the voice.
witchmod.compendium.neutral_aggression.d: This curse makes the victim even more unlikable; Any nearby neutral mobs automatically aggress onto the victim.
witchmod.compendium.oversharer.desc: This curse makes the victim uncontrollably announce occasionally useful information about themselves and their location in chat to the whole server.
witchmod.compendium.pacing.desc: A curse that makes your gameplay paced like a certain show people swear is worth your time. Combat can force all nearby entities into a drawn out cutscene to see their reactions to the predicament.
witchmod.compendium.pests.desc: A minor annoyance of a curse that makes it so breaking blocks has a chance to spawn silverfish.
witchmod.compendium.popularity.desc: This curse makes the victim the most popular person ever - by majorly increasing hostile mob spawn rates and aggro around them.
witchmod.compendium.repel.desc: Dropped items and XP orbs on the floor slide slowly away from you, drifting toward the nearest hazard.
witchmod.compendium.screensaver.desc: A 4th wall-breaking curse that will occasionally force the victim's Minecraft window to bounce around like a screensaver.
witchmod.compendium.screensaver.rumour: Rumour has it that this curse can interact with the very window of the game. Something used to contain art within a frame could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.sirens_call.desc: A curse that makes the victim yearn for water. The longer they spend out of water, the more debuffs they get. If they are out of water for too long, they lose control of themselves and start heading to the closest water. Drowned do not attack people with this curse, for some reason.
witchmod.compendium.slippery_feet.desc: Hanging over ledges with this curse has a good chance to make you slip and fall.
witchmod.compendium.snail.desc: A magic immortal snail is always chasing you. If it touches you, you explode, (there is no benefit) do you take the deal?
witchmod.compendium.social_outcast.desc: It is extremely difficult to see other players and villagers unless very close.
witchmod.compendium.solicitor.desc: Curses you with a socially unaware salesman who treats you like you expressed an ounce of interest in their craft. You can't kill them. You can't escape.
witchmod.compendium.solicitor.rumour: Rumours state that there are individuals, so lacking in self respect, they will spend their time bothering others Bundle
witchmod.compendium.splitscreen.desc: The curse that forces a player to play 'splitscreen' with a nearby player, both players must play in this state and UIs such as signs stop both players until complete. (I tried my best to get this to work)
witchmod.compendium.splitscreen.rumour: Siblings speak of a curse on their relationship, where even the strongest of bonds, could be broken. any Sign
witchmod.compendium.spotlight.desc: A curse that reveals the victim to others (including entities), making them glow and putting a huge beam of light above them.
witchmod.compendium.spotlight.rumour: I heard of a story about a lying ancient, starved for attention, trying to get it by any means necessary Glowstone
witchmod.compendium.stick_drift.desc: This adds drift to the victim's camera or movement, in a consistent direction and works in spells - Just like an unnamed console!
witchmod.compendium.stick_drift.rumour: Rumour has it companies poorly design hardware to siphon more money off a consumer Fishing Rod
witchmod.compendium.sticky.desc: Victims become super sticky and cannot take armour off, or drop items due to their stickiness.
witchmod.compendium.sticky.rumour: Texts speak of an organic curse of binding, Honey Bottle
witchmod.compendium.thirst_meter.desc: Adds a functional thirst meter to the victim that ticks down faster in hot biomes and can be restored by drinking from water blocks (which can cause sickness) or bottles.
witchmod.compendium.thirst_meter.rumour: Crowds desired this curse for some reason. Water Bottle
witchmod.compendium.trumpet.desc: Makes it so a 'stereotypical' trumpet music plays when the victim walks or sprints.
witchmod.compendium.trumpet.rumour: The eldery speak of cartoon characters and music in a very outdated way. Cookie
witchmod.compendium.ugly.desc: A curse that changes the victim's skin to an 'ugly' (or funny) skin for the duration.
witchmod.compendium.ugly.rumour: There are legends about ugly people. Carved Pumpkin
witchmod.compendium.unhygienic.desc: This curse turns you into a Redditor for the duration; You are extremely smelly and nearby (non-undead) mobs run away from you, nearby players also drift away from you.
witchmod.compendium.unhygienic.rumour: Rumours speak of individuals, lacking in social awareness, invading spaces and driving everyone out. Rotten Flesh
witchmod.compendium.vertigo.desc: A curse that gives you a fear of heights. The higher you are the more of a camera and movement sway you have..
witchmod.compendium.vertigo.rumour: A curse that seems to instill the fear of heights into the victim. Scaffolding
witchmod.compendium.very_infectious.desc: A modifier (Slime Block), not a curse: a stronger Infectious that spreads the target's attachments to nearby players.
witchmod.compendium.violence.desc: A curse that gives you violent tendencies; You can't help but hit nearby entities.
witchmod.compendium.violence.rumour: There's a curse out there that makes people uncontrollably violent Iron Sword
witchmod.compendium.volatile.desc: An explosive curse that makes it so when you take damage there's a small chance you explode, this explosion does significantly less damage to the victim, however.
witchmod.compendium.volatile.rumour: I heard a rumour of a hex cast on an unfortunate soul, making them combust spontaneously, TNT
witchmod.compendium.wonky.desc: A curse that influences your movement, making you unable to walk in a straight line by being wobbly.
witchmod.compendium.wonky.rumour: Rumours speak of a curse that influences the victim's coordination, Feather
witchmod.compendium.yap.desc: This curse makes you uncontrollably chat utter nonsense all the time, this can give away your actions or be annoying AND unfunny!
witchmod.compendium.yap.rumour: I heard of an ancient hex, making the victim spout nonsense uncontrollably, sounds like it would use something you could fill with words.
witchmod.compendium.bloodhound.desc: A tracking blessing, that makes nearby mobs and players leave 'scent trails' where they have walked.
witchmod.compendium.bloodhound.rumour: Hunters used to cast an ancient blessing to hunt down deserters. . Sniffer Egg
witchmod.compendium.dexterous.desc: With this blessing, you find dexterity-based tasks significantly easier: Animations like eating and using bows are significantly eaiser: Crossbow enchantments like multishot have tighter spread and all arrows can hit one target.
witchmod.compendium.dexterous.rumour: There's a way to greatly enhance your dexterity, a special kind of arrow is said to be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.guardian_angel.desc: A blessing that provides the player with your very own guardian angel. This angel helps you with tasks, lighting up areas and combat by dealing damage, stunning, blinding and highlighting the strongest enemy, highlighted enemies take extra damage from you. This angel can be killed.
witchmod.compendium.guardian_angel.rumou: Legends speak of an ancient blessing, bestowing a kind and helpful spirit onto someone, Golden Apple
witchmod.compendium.leader.desc: Makes you the group leader by providing buffs to all nearby players when you have this blessing. A true leader does not need buffs and therefore you do not recieve anything.
witchmod.compendium.leader.rumour: I heard of a leader, able to rally their forces into any battle. Golden Helmet
witchmod.compendium.underdog.desc: The lower your health, the stronger you get — buffs kick in below half health and grow stronger below a quarter.
witchmod.compendium.anchor.desc: A blessing that makes you an anchor, you cannot be moved by any external forces.
witchmod.compendium.anchor.rumour: Texts speak of an immovable figure, able to take on armies. Chain
witchmod.compendium.angler.desc: A good blessing for when you have Gone Fishing; Greatly increases chances for a fishing bite and drops from fishing.
witchmod.compendium.angler.rumour: Old fishermen speak of a way to substantially increase your fishing luck when on a voyage. Salmon
witchmod.compendium.army.desc: A blessing that turns aggressive mobs into your friends and makes them attack and protect you from anyone or anything that attacks you.
witchmod.compendium.army.rumour: Legends speak of a figure able to command the masses of undead mobs to their will. Shield
witchmod.compendium.backstabbing.desc: A blessing that doubles your damage on mobs and players from behind.
witchmod.compendium.backstabbing.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing used by assassins to strike foes down from behind. Nether Brick
witchmod.compendium.berserker.desc: A blessing that decreases the hit cooldown the more melee hits you succeed in a row, missing resets this reduction and it decays if you haven't hit for a while.
witchmod.compendium.berserker.rumour: Texts speak of magic that can turn your fury into stamina, increasing your swing speed. Iron Axe
witchmod.compendium.blacksmith.desc: A blessing that increases your smithing skills; decreasing anvil XP costs and removing the too expensive limit.
witchmod.compendium.blacksmith.rumour: I heard a rumour about a blessing that makes smithing cheaper and easier. Copper Block
witchmod.compendium.bodyguard.desc: Makes a bodyguard follow you around and protect you from any threats, pushing away any nearby entities and being overconfident in chat to everyone nearby.
witchmod.compendium.bodyguard.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing that employs a personal strongman to protect you. Bone
witchmod.compendium.brute.desc: This blessing makes your sprint charge up into a Juggernaut charge, where you can run through mobs and into walls and resist all knockback.
witchmod.compendium.brute.rumour: I heard of a blessing that turns you into a budget Juggernaut. Iron Helmet
witchmod.compendium.builder.desc: A blessing that removes the vanilla delay between placing and breaking blocks, making it very fast to build and mine - but this can be inconvient at times.
witchmod.compendium.builder.rumour: There seems to be a blessing that removes a foundational feature from mining and building. any Planks
witchmod.compendium.chat.desc: This blessing makes you stream your gameplay to a very normal audience, where their retention is based on your gameplay and actions, higher viewcounts provide you with more subs and subs give you a payout of emeralds once this blessing ends.
witchmod.compendium.chat.rumour: There seems to be some sort of blessing that gives you more money than others for just pretending to be someone you're not... Purple Wool
witchmod.compendium.collector.desc: A blessing that pulls nearby stray items and experience towards you.
witchmod.compendium.collector.rumour: There seems to be a spell that makes you a magnet. Barrel
witchmod.compendium.confusion.desc: This blessing makes you produce clones that attack the nearby mobs, making it very confusing to fight, these die instantly and do minimal damage.
witchmod.compendium.confusion.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing able to produce clones of people. Rabbit Hide
witchmod.compendium.cow.desc: This blessing lets you and others milk you using a bucket?
witchmod.compendium.cow.rumour: I heard of a way to make others... milkable for some reason... why? Leather
witchmod.compendium.coyote.desc: A weak blessing that increases your coyote time when off blocks and pulls you towards blocks when midair, attempting to make you better at parkour.
witchmod.compendium.coyote.rumour: There's a blessing that seems to loosely help with parkour. Raw Beef
witchmod.compendium.disguise.desc: A blessing that makes you look like an animal to others (including hostile entities), getting too close to a hostile mob or getting hit breaks this disguise temporarily.
witchmod.compendium.disguise.rumour: There's a way to make yourself pass as an animal to others Armor Stand
witchmod.compendium.drive.desc: Your presence with this blessing increases the drive of nearby animals for... some reason? This completely removes the breeding cooldown and makes villagers more likely to breed.
witchmod.compendium.drive.rumour: Questionable texts speak of a way to make breeding animals much more... intense. Golden Carrot
witchmod.compendium.enchanter.desc: A blessing that makes you more proficient with magic, cheapening enchant costs and removing some of the more useless vanilla enchantments from being applied at the table.
witchmod.compendium.enchanter.rumour: Legends speak of a way to increase your enchanting skills. Lapis Lazuli
witchmod.compendium.excavation.desc: A blessing intended for digging out large areas quickly; The more blocks you break in a small window increase your mining speed.
witchmod.compendium.excavation.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing used by ancient miners to mine out large areas quickly. Iron Pickaxe
witchmod.compendium.farmers_spirit.desc: This blessing makes nearby foliage and crops grow quickly around you in a small radius.
witchmod.compendium.farmers_spirit.rumou: Rumours speak of a blessing able to enhance the growth speeds of nearby plants. Carrot
witchmod.compendium.flight.desc: A blessing that lets you fly on a resource, where taking damage uses some of this resource. By not sprinting you will surge up quicker and sprint-flying will increase your horizontal movement.
witchmod.compendium.flight.rumour: Rumours suggest actually I don't need to say this one its in the name. Ghast Tear
witchmod.compendium.forgiveness.desc: Makes Minecraft a bit more forgiving; Hitboxes for entities are increased for you, making melee, or projectile hits much easier.
witchmod.compendium.forgiveness.rumour: Rumours speak of a blessing that changes the very foundations of the game in your favour. Name Tag
witchmod.compendium.fortune.desc: Adds an extra layer of fortune when mining your ores, giving you 1-3 extra items from mining ores, this stacks with fortune enchantments.
witchmod.compendium.fortune.rumour: Legends speak of a way to further increase your fortune past enchantments. Diamond
witchmod.compendium.fullness.desc: A blessing that slows your metabolism to a halt, making it so you don't get hungry for the entire duration.
witchmod.compendium.fullness.rumour: Rumours suggest a blessing able to suppress your appetite. Bread
witchmod.compendium.gladiator.desc: A gimmick that makes it so (when not holding a shield!) you are able to parry, if hit during a parry you automatically riposte, dealing high knockback, bonus damage and restoring your weapon and parry cooldown.
witchmod.compendium.gladiator.rumour: There is a blessing out there that allows you to block and retaliate against attacks you foresee. Golden Sword
witchmod.compendium.hawk_guy.desc: Shows others that purple's not that funny (whatever that means) by making your projectiles home in on the nearest target you are looking at.
witchmod.compendium.hawk_guy.rumour: Legends speak of a blessing that can rig the environment in your favour when your skill fails. Target Block
witchmod.compendium.heavy_hitter.desc: Your melee hits knock targets back about twice as far, stacking with the Knockback enchantment.
witchmod.compendium.homebody.desc: A blessing that makes you very comfortable within your home, giving you regeneration and haste when near your spawnpoint..
witchmod.compendium.homebody.rumour: I heard of a blessing that can turn homely comfort into strength, the most basic and well-known variation of a bed is how I cast this.
witchmod.compendium.hot_stuff.desc: You become smoking hot with this blessing, making any active furnace you look at start smelting at a greatly increased speed.
witchmod.compendium.hot_stuff.rumour: Texts speak of a blessing that assists with smelting, there is a clear item, most commonly used for smelting that I could use here.
witchmod.compendium.hype_man.desc: A good blessing for lonely people: Forces nearby players to praise your actions (and looks!) in chat.
witchmod.compendium.hype_man.rumour: Political texts speak of a power to make those, even if they hate you, speak your name and praise you needlessly. any Music Disc
witchmod.compendium.immortality.desc: Upon death, this blessing allows you to revive yourself up to 3 times, with a small, increasing time to revive per death.
witchmod.compendium.immortality.rumour: There are legends of an ancient spell, able to allow you to rebuild yourself after death, the remains of the creature of decay are said to be used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.iron_lung.desc: A blessing that makes you incapable of suffocation by any means, allowing you to go underwater and be inside blocks without any damage.
witchmod.compendium.iron_lung.rumour: Rumours suggest a blessing able to make your lungs impermeable to anything, a persistent and populous underwater plant could be used in this spell.
witchmod.compendium.iron_stomach.desc: This blessing allows you to eat any bad foods, like rotten flesh and poisonous potatoes freely, gaining the hunger and saturation benefits as if it was a delectable meal.
witchmod.compendium.iron_stomach.rumour: Rumours suggest there is a blessing that allows you to eat even the most vile of foods, represented by the most pivotal inedible food. It pretty much gives you the British palette.
witchmod.compendium.jesus.desc: You are able to walk on water, you walk faster with depth strider and can crouch to enter the water.
witchmod.compendium.jesus.rumour: Old texts speak of a mysterious man able to walk on water, maybe I could use a plant that floats on the water's surface to replicate this...
witchmod.compendium.last_stand.desc: A killing blow instead revives you with brief invulnerability, buffs and a knockback burst — a limited number of times, on an escalating cooldown.
witchmod.compendium.last_stand.rumour: There's a blessing out there that lets you revive upon death, giving fighters one more chance for victory, essence from a very rare food that effectively provides immortality could cast this.
witchmod.compendium.laugh_track.desc: Everytime you write in chat with this blessing, all players will hear an audible crowd laugh and cheer, fun fact: this is really annoying and isn't funny after the first time.
witchmod.compendium.laugh_track.rumour: I heard of an annoying curse for unfunny people, represented by an item used to make chocolate... for some reason?
witchmod.compendium.low_gravity.desc: This blessing makes you less affected by gravity, you jump higher, fall slower and take less fall damage
witchmod.compendium.low_gravity.rumour: I feel like this name is self explanatory, the item used to enter the End should be able to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.luck.desc: This blessing significantly increases your vanilla luck stat, this is useful I promise.
witchmod.compendium.luck.rumour: I heard of a blessing that makes you luckier, cast with an item heavily associated with luck.
witchmod.compendium.main_character.desc: A blessing that makes you better under pressure; when surrounded by hostile entities intense music will begin to play and your attack speed, knockback and damage will be significantly increased, with higher buffs from more entities.
witchmod.compendium.main_character.rumou: Rumours suggest this blessing can help you when under pressure, perhaps something destructive and volatile from the nether could cast this.
witchmod.compendium.nightowl.desc: You do not get your sight hampered by anything; Blindness, darkness, fog and all other visual obstructions do not affect you with this blessing.
witchmod.compendium.nightowl.rumour: There's a blessing that makes your sight unable to be obstructed, a light-producing fruit is said to be able to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.ninja.desc: You move faster, attack faster and gain a double jump.
witchmod.compendium.ninja.rumour: I've heard of a power that gives you the abilities of a ninja, able to be cast with the dye used to tint used to dye old ninja's clothing.
witchmod.compendium.oceans_blessing.desc: Makes you swim much faster and draw nearby dolphins to swim with you for a big speed boost; aggressive water mobs are also pacified.
witchmod.compendium.oceans_blessing.rumo: People speak of magic used by swimmers to travel through vast seas in absolute safety, any hard sea plant should allow me to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.organised.desc: Gives you an extra inventory row by clicking the wardrobe icon at the bottom of your inventory. This acts as an Ender chest and will not drop when you die etc. But once this blessing ends, all stored items will return to your inventory.
witchmod.compendium.organised.rumour: It seems there's a blessing that increases your organisational skills significantly, this cleary will use the shell of creatures, dedicated to storage.
witchmod.compendium.pacifier.desc: A blessing that can preserve the environment around you, where nearby destructive events like explosions and fire are not able to occur.
witchmod.compendium.pacifier.rumour: I've heard of a blessing that stopped griefers from blowing up a castle and it was cast using a pleasant, purple flower,
witchmod.compendium.payday.desc: Having this blessing makes it so when you are alone and peaceful, there's a good chance a tax collector will visit and provide any collected taxes.
witchmod.compendium.payday.rumour: Rumours say that sometimes, taxes go towards actually good things, maybe we can make this true using a valuable item, used to store large amounts of wealth.
witchmod.compendium.peace.desc: Significantly reduces mob spawn rates around the blessed person, providing some much needed peace and quiet.
witchmod.compendium.peace.rumour: There is a blessing that can give you peace, even in dark and dangerous areas. People speak of a flower that grows in old warzones, when peace struck a once chaotic area.
witchmod.compendium.photosynthesis.desc: In direct sunlight you slowly regenerate health and hunger, more strongly while standing in water — the opposite of Basement Dweller.
witchmod.compendium.photosynthesis.rumou: There seems to be a blessing that can allow you to do some form of photosynthesis, a plant which is specially adapted for such a process would be great for this.
witchmod.compendium.pickpocket.desc: A blessing that makes you very good with your fingers. By standing near other players you have a chance to take items from they inventory passively, this chance is significantly increased if you are behind them.
witchmod.compendium.pickpocket.rumour: There seems to be a way to take items from other's inventories, I could use a simple ingredient, usually used to bind or hang objects.
witchmod.compendium.prop_hunt.desc: this makes you very good at hiding, crouching with this blessing transforms you into the block below and anchors you to the grid. Uncrouching will then allow you to walk around as said block, taking damage breaks this disguise.
witchmod.compendium.prop_hunt.rumour: Rumour has it there's a way for you to camouflage with your environment flawlessly, something along the lines of a generic, decorative item could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.reflect.desc: A blessing that makes you very reflective, so any projectiles that hit you are returned to sender at a higher velocity.
witchmod.compendium.reflect.rumour: There's a blessing out there that can make your skin impermeable to all projectiles, a part of an animals shell seems suitable to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.restock.desc: A quality of life blessing: Refills stackable items in your hotbar from your inventory when used. Probably useless in a modpack.
witchmod.compendium.restock.rumour: Legends say there's a blessing that can ease inventory management, a basic storage block would probably be good for this.
witchmod.compendium.safety.desc: This blessing allows you to travel to your spawnpoint up to 3 times with a cooldown. Crouching and standing still starts a countdown that will return you to your spawnpoint if you're not damaged in this time, other players can hear and see that you are attempting to teleport to your spawnpoint.
witchmod.compendium.safety.rumour: Rumours suggest a blessing that can transport you home to safety, a device, used for safety in other dimesions seems to be a good fit here.
witchmod.compendium.sanguine.desc: This blessing makes you regenerate by other means; Your natural regeneration is significantly reduced, but you gain small lifesteal on all damage you recieve.
witchmod.compendium.sanguine.rumour: There seems to be a blessing that can change your means of regeneration, cast using something of a similar hue to blood.
witchmod.compendium.silver_tongue.desc: A blessing that makes you a charmer to those big-nosed fellas, significantly haggling down trade prices to the minimum (they want you bro).
witchmod.compendium.silver_tongue.rumour: There's a blessing out there that can make you a real charmer, where people cannot help but give you discounts, a block made of the currency is rumoured to help cast this.
witchmod.compendium.sixth_sense.desc: A blessing that alerts you via an actionbar to nearby structures and entities. Rarer structures like ancient cities will always take priority.
witchmod.compendium.sixth_sense.rumour: Rumour has it there's a blessing that gives you a 'gut feeling' on things nearby, clearly a common item used for navigation represents this.
witchmod.compendium.sonar.desc: This blessing charges up a huge sonar scan overtime, once it unleashes all nearby entities will be revealed to all players nearby briefly. Taking damage charges the scan quicker.
witchmod.compendium.sonar.rumour: There's a blessing out there that can alert you to the presence of huge groups easily, like that of particular sculk devices.
witchmod.compendium.soul_bond.desc: This blessing discharges a percentage of damage you take onto others: The closest entity to you will gain the soul bound effect, remotely taking a small percentage of damage you take instead of you.
witchmod.compendium.soul_bond.rumour: Rumours suggest there's a blessing that can tie your very vitality to others, a valuable, but unusually light block is rumoured to be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.speed.desc: A blessing that significantly increases your speed when sprinting, as the same saturation cost.
witchmod.compendium.speed.rumour: A blessing that seems to help you run faster, rumoured to be cast with an item that provides a brief rush.
witchmod.compendium.speed_demon.desc: Any vehicle you ride — a mob, a minecart or a boat — moves much faster.
witchmod.compendium.speed_demon.rumour: There's a blessing that seems to be able to increase the speed of your mounts, rumours suggest a niche item, used to navigate the most ancient of mounts uses this.
witchmod.compendium.spelunking.desc: Nearby ores emit noticeable particles, improving cave exploration.
witchmod.compendium.spelunking.rumour: Sources say there's a blessing that makes nearby ore more noticeable, a block used by miners to see could show this.
witchmod.compendium.spider.desc: A blessing that gives you the traits of a spider; letting you climb and leap off walls freely.
witchmod.compendium.spider.rumour: A blessing that seems to give you a significant trait of a spider: Use an item that is exclusively a spider's to cast this blessing.
witchmod.compendium.studious.desc: This blessing multiplies the amount of XP you take in from any source.
witchmod.compendium.studious.rumour: Legends say there's a blessing that multiplies your experience intake, which is cast with an item used for learning.
witchmod.compendium.tank.desc: This blessing seems to make you a lot more resistant to damage by doubling your health bar, at the cost of some regeneration speed.
witchmod.compendium.tank.rumour: It is said there is a blessing that can boost your very vitality, rumoured to be cast using a tougher variant of cobblestone.
witchmod.compendium.thick_skinned.desc: Chip damage doesn't get to you: Lower instances of damage are completely blocked from affecting you.
witchmod.compendium.thick_skinned.rumour: Sources state that there's a blessing that makes you impervious to minor amounts of damage, maybe a remnant of a creature's shell could be used for this.
witchmod.compendium.thunder.desc: A blessing that increases your melee strength significantly: Time spent not swinging charges up bonus damage and effects for your next hit, capable of dealing bonus damage, setting targets on fire, chaining between targets and smiting them with additional lightning at higher levels.
witchmod.compendium.thunder.rumour: Rumours say there's a blessing that gives you the power to smite others, there's a tool out there that can also smite others, this probably has something to do with this.
witchmod.compendium.trainer.desc: Villagers you train with gain significantly more XP with this blessing and level up instantly.
witchmod.compendium.trainer.rumour: A blessing that seems to assist in the training of others. Rumours suggest that an item used to store and gain XP can cast this blessing.
witchmod.compendium.twinkletoes.desc: You take no fall damage, landing softly however far you drop.
witchmod.compendium.twinkletoes.rumour: A blessing that seems to somehow invalidate gravity, a block used to bring down fall damage could symbolise this.
witchmod.compendium.twist_of_fate.desc: Instances of damage occasionally can be invalidated, as if they never happened.
witchmod.compendium.twist_of_fate.rumour: A blessing that seems to change fate somehow, rumoured to be cast using an item capable of healing a dragon.
witchmod.compendium.unseen.desc: This blessing makes it impossible for others to see you, unless you get close, where a noticeable sound could give you away.
witchmod.compendium.unseen.rumour: Rumours suggest this blessing is able to hide you from others, I think something natural and used to obscure animals from predators makes sense here.
witchmod.compendium.vein_miner.desc: Mining any ores or logs with this blessing instantly breaks all blocks of the same type, still applying any fortune effects and consuming the same amount of durability as if one block was broken.
witchmod.compendium.vein_miner.rumour: Sources say this blessing allows you to bulk break veins of ore and log in one swing, a generic and necessary ore should symbolise this.
witchmod.compendium.windfall.desc: A blessing that influences fate; Random items occasionally drift past you in the wind.
witchmod.compendium.windfall.rumour: A blessing that may influence wind and your luck. An item that unleashes bursts of wind could be used to cast this.
witchmod.compendium.workman.desc: You are so proficient with your tools that any tools do not take any durability damage.
witchmod.compendium.workman.rumour: There's a blessing that can influence your proficiency with tools, something difficult to break should represent this.
witchmod.compendium.amethyst_bell.desc: A ringable gambling bell. Ringing sends out a shockwave: nearby players with no curses/blessings have a chance to be handed a random batch, and anyone who already carries some has each one re-rolled for another of the same category at a similar power (with rare lucky/unlucky swings). After each ring it goes inactive for 30 minutes.
witchmod.compendium.bewitching_table.des:
The main workstation for casting blessings/curses onto a target. The table has 4 slots:
Cursed Essence - The currency/investment, the more of the cursed essence item you invest the higher chance the spell is cast successfully.
Sacrificial Item - The item that selects the curse/blessing. Not all items can be used here and the slot will turn red if invalid, you can view the rumours in the curses/blessings section of this compendium to find out what items cast what spells.
The Target - This slot decides who the spell will target. If left empty it will always target the one casting the spell, you can also put in someone's player essence (see items to see how to retrieve) or similarly a voodoo doll, which will use some durability.
Modifer - An optional slot that could add additional effects.
witchmod.compendium.blessed_coin.desc: A magic coin imbued with mystical energy. Flipping it bestows 1-3 random blessings.
witchmod.compendium.blessed_jar.desc:
A jar containing exclusively blessings. Throwing it will bestow these blessings to one hit player.
Fill an empty jar at a ritual table using sacrificial items to acquire.
witchmod.compendium.compendium.desc: A book that details your blessing and curse discoveries, as well as tutorials and descriptions for items and blocks included in this mod.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_coin.desc: A magic coin imbued with cursed energy. Flipping it bestows 1-3 random curses, with a higher likelihood for more powerful curses.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_essence.desc: Mystical energy refined from amethyst. Used as a currency in rituals and for many crafting recipes.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_essence_block: A storage block for cursed essence. Can be used in the ritual table and counts as 9x cursed essence.
witchmod.compendium.cursed_jar.desc:
A jar containing exclusively curses. Throwing it will curse one hit player.
Fill an empty jar at a ritual table using sacrificial items to acquire.
witchmod.compendium.effigy.desc: A magic artefact that allows you to forward all your active blessings and curses to another player at the exact times and stages. You must be very close to do this and it breaks on success.
witchmod.compendium.executioners_coin.de: An ancient coin imbued with mysterious energy. Flipping it can grant up to 1-3 random blessings or curses.
witchmod.compendium.jar.desc:
A simple jar that can store many things. Using it on a player's bed or player will imbue it with their essence, which can be used as a target during rituals.
It can also be used to store blessings and curses in a ritual table in cursed/blessed/mixed jars.
witchmod.compendium.ledger.desc: A block that logs all nearby magic based events, showing you the magic, target, caster and if it was successful or not. Entries expire over time.
witchmod.compendium.mixed_jar.desc:
A jar containing a mix of curses and blessings. Throwing it will curse one hit player.
Fill an empty jar at a ritual table using sacrificial items to acquire.
witchmod.compendium.needle.desc: A simple item used to inflict pain on anyone bound to a voodoo doll. Using the item with a voodoo doll or right clicking the needle into a voodoo doll will damage whoever it is bound to, partially piercing armour.
witchmod.compendium.player_essence.desc: A jar that contains the essence of a player, acquired from using an empty jar on a player or their bed. Can be used to target individuals for rituals or bind them to a voodoo doll.
witchmod.compendium.purifying_water_buck: A bucket that stores holy water. Standing in holy water protects you from all magic (unless directly thrown at you using a jar) and quickly burns down any blessing or curse timers.
witchmod.compendium.holy_water.recipe_no: Not crafted. Imbue a cauldron of water with an amethyst shard to consecrate it into Holy Water, then bottle it with a bucket.
witchmod.compendium.scrying_mirror.desc: A magic artefact that allows you to see yours or other's active blessings and curses as well as specific details on use.
witchmod.compendium.voodoo_doll.desc:
A magic item that can be bound to a player using their essence in a crafting UI or by simply right clicking in the inventory.
Interactions like throwing it, squeezing  it (by right clicking), throwing potions at it, burning it in fire and more have real world effects on the victim.
A ward can be used to prevent this.
witchmod.compendium.ward.desc: An artefact that repels any form of spells or voodoo magic while in your inventory at a durability cost. When repelled this visual will tell you if it was a curse or a blessing and the direction it was sent from.
witchmod.compendium.warding_totem.desc: A magic totem that protects all nearby players from any magic type (apart from direct hits using jars). Can be right-clicked to toggle and self-inflicted magic should not be protected.
